name: Bai Xiaoying
source:
“When you live in a place for that long, you leave far more than mere memories behind.”

A girl with a love of literature. She’s Han Feng’s girlfriend, Xia Lü’s best friend, and the Detective Club’s “consultant.” One of her favorite pastimes is teasing Han Feng.
